html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

In this patch, you will be able to meet 
the Ruler of the Dark Dimension and the Sorcerer Supreme.


Tier-4 and New Uniforms have been added to 
Dormammu, an extra-dimensional being made of pure magical energy, 
and Clea, a sorceress who inherited the power of both the Faltine and the Dark Dimension.

 

Agents, please download the 10/27 (Tue) patch 
to check out their new skills and enhanced power!

 

■ 10/27 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 10/28 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 10/27 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ Two New Uniforms


Two new uniforms, Dormammu <The Living Dark Planet>, 
and Clea <Death of Doctor Strange> have been added.
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The two new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the ‘<Uncle and Niece> Update Celebration Event’ and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.


* To celebrate the Ruler of the Dark Dimension update, a 10% Agent Supplies discount coupon will be distributed.
- Coupon acquisition and available period: 
10/27 (Tue) 15:00 – 11/10 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
10/27 (Tue) 8:00 (PDT) – 11/10 (Tue) 6:59 (PST)

 

 

 


▣ Dormammu & Clea Tier-4

 

① Dormammu

 

A Tier-4 Striker Skill has been added to Dormammu, the absolute monarch of the Dark Dimension.
He will use the Flames of the Faltine and dark magic to lead any living being that dares oppose him to their destruction.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

② Clea

 

A Tier-4 Striker Skill has been added to Clea, the rightful heir to the Dark Dimension and the ultimate sorceress.
The overwhelming magical power she unleashes will make enemies lose their will to fight.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Dormammu Max Level Expansion

 

After the October patch, Dormammu's maximum level will be expanded.
Experience the thrill of surpassing limits and reaching new heights.

 


* The max level expansion for each hero will proceed sequentially through updates.

 


▣ New Artifact
​
After the October patch, an Exclusive Passive Skill Artifact for Dormammu will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms featuring the Darkness and Magic theme.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Brilliant C.T.P. of Ascent: Adjusted the minimum and medium values for certain options on the item.
- The maximum option values remain the same as before.
- The options for any Brilliant C.T.P. of Ascent owned prior to the patch will also be adjusted automatically.

 

▶ Instinct Attack Values Increased
- Medium: 25% > 26%
- Minimum: 20% > 22%

 

▶ Reforge Options Increased
1) Increases Instinct damage dealt to boss types
- Medium: 25% > 26%
- Minimum: 20% > 22%

 

2) Excluding bosses, ignores enemy’s all damage decrease
- Medium: 20% > 21%
- Minimum: 15% > 17%


2. The background music for the Giant Boss Raid 'Onslaught' stage has been changed.


We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
